content.title: Trump Media Is Making a Big Pivot. Kodak Tried That, Too.
content.summary: Yes, we are talking about the merger between social-media platform  Trump Media & Technology  and nuclear fusion start-up TAE Technologies.  The deal values TAE at some $3 billion, creating the world’s first publicly traded nuclear fusion company, which produces energy the way a star does.  Trump Media stock rose 8.3% on Friday, after a 42% jump on Thursday, closing the week at $16.09, which left shares down 53% for the year.
